referenceGeometry.supportMethod: Mean x of alpha>=16 pixels in bottom eight pixel rows; lower exclusive alpha bound y.
referenceGeometry.referenceMethod: Maximum width/height of exact approved neutral whole-character alpha>=16 bounds. Fixed reference for all actions; not each pose bounding box.

birth.birthPivotBasis: Final complete body neutral support transformed from fullbody sheet into the full-scene camera. Nest/effects excluded from reference length.

birthFinalBodyRasterVerification.note: Runtime uses transformed continuous reference to avoid rounding size jumps. Raster bounding box differs by at most anti-alias/resampling edge tolerance.
